# +MSUM | Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova

![](/media/e452fc9525/_EES4049-750x260.jpg)

**OPEN:**

**Tuesday — Sunday 10 a.m. — 6 p.m.**

**Thursday 10 a.m. — 8 p.m. (July and August)**

 

24\. 12. and 31. 12. 10 a.m. — 15. p.m.

**CLOSED: on Mondays and 1 January, 1 May, 1 November, 25 December**

[+MSUM Venue](/en/visit/781/msum-acess/)

**ADMISSION FEE**

Adults: EUR 7.00

Students, seniors and people over 65: EUR 3.50

Groups (adults)*: EUR 5.00

Groups (students, seniors)*: EUR 3.00

Families: EUR 14.00

*Minimum group size ten people

Combined ticket adult MG+MSUM: € 10.50

Combined ticket family MG+MSUM: € 21.00

Tickets are sold up to half an hour before the gallery closes**.**

**Free admission** | every first Sunday of the month, preschool children, the unemployed, holders of the EU Disability Card and their escorts, holders of [CIMAM](http://cimam.org/), [ICOM](http://www.icom-slovenia.si/), Community of Museums of Slovenia ([SMS](http://www.sms-muzeji.si/)), Slovenian Museum Society ([SMD](http://www.smd-drustvo.si/)), Slovenian Art and History Society ([SUZD](http://www.suzd.si/)), [Ljubljana Card](https://www.visitljubljana.com/en/visitors/sights-and-activities/ljubljana-card/);

*Free admission applies to all exhibitions organized by the Museum of Modern Art and the Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova.*

**GUIDED TOURS**

Admission fee per person: EUR 1.00

Guided tours are possible by prior arrangement at least **five working days before** the desired date.

E: <izobrazevanje@mg-lj.si>

**Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova**

Maistrova 3, 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia

[+MSUM Venue](http://www.mg-lj.si/en/visit/781/msum-acess/)

**By bus** | Buses stopping in the vicinity of Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova (+MSUM).

Routes 02, 09, 12, 25, 27 – get off at the [Friškovec](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Fri%C5%A1kovec,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM,+Maistrova+ulica+3,+1000+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/@46.0566424,14.5150862,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765328486e084af:0x6bfe3c6437f457bc!2m2!1d14.516762!2d46.057581!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653283bc8a6f2b:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) [(301012)](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Fri%C5%A1kovec,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM,+Maistrova+ulica+3,+1000+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/@46.0562329,14.5149843,17z/data=!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765328486e084af:0x6bfe3c6437f457bc!2m2!1d14.516762!2d46.057581!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653283bc8a6f2b:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) or [Friškovec (301011)](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Fri%C5%A1kovec,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM/@46.0565747,14.5155225,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653284739dff0d:0x4cbc0991a18d72d1!2m2!1d14.518304!2d46.05736!1m5!1m1!1s0x0:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) stops.

Route 05 – get off at the [Ilirska (501011)](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Ilirska,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM/@46.0543258,14.5133482,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653282834aebe1:0xbd6c8f222b763ca6!2m2!1d14.513772!2d46.052953!1m5!1m1!1s0x0:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) or [Ilirska (501012)](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Ilirska,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM/@46.0543258,14.5135166,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765328283f100cf:0xfebf58a0abbe7908!2m2!1d14.514108!2d46.052952!1m5!1m1!1s0x0:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) stops.

Routes 02, 05, 06, 06B, 07, 07L, 08, 09, 11, 11B, 13, 14, 14B, 18, 19B, 19I, 20, 25, 27 – get off at the [Bavarski dvor (600012)](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/Bavarski+dvor,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM/@46.0561971,14.5071647,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329e89c0f893:0xa2f8d085ef5db6a0!2m2!1d14.505365!2d46.056308!1m5!1m1!1s0x0:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) or [Bavarski dvor (600011)](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/Bavarski+dvor,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM/@46.0561971,14.5071647,16z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329e8e46ba17:0x4673bcd781524157!2m2!1d14.505598!2d46.056726!1m5!1m1!1s0x0:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) stops.

**By train** | The [Ljubljana railway station](https://potniski.sz.si/en/) is approximately a [ten-minute walk](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/%C5%BDelezni%C5%A1ka+postaja+Ljubljana,+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM,+Maistrova+ulica+3,+1000+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/@46.0567166,14.5123371,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329c7f4da3f3:0x6415e87febc841!2m2!1d14.512684!2d46.05873!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653283bc8a6f2b:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e2) from Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova. Alternatively, you can take a [bus](http://www.google.com/maps/dir/%C5%BDelezni%C5%A1ka+postaja+Ljubljana,+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/Muzej+sodobne+umetnosti+Metelkova+|+%2B+MSUM,+Maistrova+ulica+3,+1000+Ljubljana,+Slovenija/@46.0572126,14.5121858,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x4765329c7f4da3f3:0x6415e87febc841!2m2!1d14.512684!2d46.05873!1m5!1m1!1s0x47653283bc8a6f2b:0x41bd17112d62b37d!2m2!1d14.517032!2d46.055707!3e3).

**By car** | In the streets around Museum of Contemporary Art Metelkova (+MSUM) there are short-term parking areas (with automated payment machines). There are also parking lots and parking garages in the vicinity ([Parking Facilities](https://www.lpt.si/en)).

**ACCESS**

All the floors of the museum are accessible by elevator and stairs. Contacts: +386 1 2416 800, +386 1 2416 825, info@mg-lj.si

Main entrance between Maistrova Street and the museum plaza. The entrance is suitable for physically disabled persons or a stroller.
